1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem that has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature and a smooth articulating surface.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is spherically or elliptically shaped and further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said humeral surface component.

20. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has a length that is adjustable wherein said stem extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 20 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper, and a screw.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem with a screw that is adjustable in length.
